title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_en:
Wang Mei Zhi Ke
Children's Edition
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《望梅止渴》的幼儿版封面，画面中一位古代将领手持旗帜，抬头望向空中飘浮的梅子，标题以绿色大字呈现。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh:
有一年夏天，天气热极了，
曹操带着一队人马赶路。他们已经走了很多天，都快要累倒了。
page_text_en:
One summer, it was extremely hot.
Cao Cao led a troop of men and horses on a journey. They had been traveling for many days and were almost exhausted.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了曹操带领军队在酷热的夏天长途跋涉，士兵和战马都已疲惫不堪的场景。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: “哎呀呀，热死了，热死了！我们都快要烤成土豆了！”士兵们被太阳晒得脑袋发晕，眼睛发花，大颗的汗珠“啪嗒啪嗒”地掉在地上。
page_text_en: "Oh my, it's so hot, so hot! We're almost being roasted like potatoes!" The soldiers were so hot from the sun that their heads spun, their eyes blurred, and big drops of sweat fell to the ground with a 'plop, plop'.
summary_zh: 士兵们在酷热的天气中行军，被太阳晒得头晕眼花，汗流浃背，抱怨天气炎热。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: 一路上，没有一座房子，也看不到一个人，士兵们连一滴水也没弄到。
page_text_en: Along the way, there was not a single house, nor could they see a single person. The soldiers didn't even manage to get a drop of water.
summary_zh: 画面描绘了士兵们在荒芜的道路上行军，沿途没有房屋和人烟，连一滴水也找不到，处境十分艰难。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: “哎呀呀，渴死了，渴死了！再也走不动了！”大家的嗓子眼儿里像要冒火一样，嘴唇干裂，渗出了血。
page_text_en: "Oh my, I'm so thirsty, so thirsty! I can't walk anymore!" Everyone's throat felt like it was on fire, their lips cracked and bleeding.
summary_zh: 士兵们在酷热中行军，极度口渴，嗓子冒火，嘴唇干裂出血，再也走不动了。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: “扑通！”有人倒了下去，再也爬不起来了。那些身体强壮的士兵也越走越慢了。
page_text_en: "Puff!" Someone fell down and couldn't get up anymore. Even the strong soldiers were walking slower and slower.
summary_zh: 士兵们在酷热中行军，有人因极度疲惫而倒下，连强壮的士兵也步履艰难。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: “还没打仗，大家就先倒下了，这可怎么办呢？”曹操看着士兵越来越少，心里非常着急。
page_text_en: "We haven't even fought yet, and everyone is already collapsing—what are we going to do?" Cao Cao looked at the decreasing number of soldiers and felt very anxious.
summary_zh: 曹操看到士兵因酷热和口渴而不断倒下，人数越来越少，感到非常焦急。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh:
曹操催马跑上一座小山，他东瞧瞧，
西望望，想看看哪里有河流或者湖泊。
page_text_en: Cao Cao urged his horse up a small hill. He looked east and west, trying to find a river or a lake.
summary_zh: 曹操骑马登上小山，四处张望，寻找水源以解士兵们的口渴。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: 可是，他只看到大片大片干裂的土地，根本就找不到水。
page_text_en: But he only saw vast, cracked land and couldn't find any water at all.
summary_zh: 曹操登上小山寻找水源，但只看到干裂的土地，一滴水也找不到，他感到非常焦急。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，士兵们已经渴得受不了了，
有的“哎哟哎哟”痛苦地叫着，有的
连叫的力气都没有了。
page_text_en:
At this moment, the soldiers could no longer bear the thirst.
Some were crying out in pain, "Aiyo, aiyo," while others
had no strength left even to cry.
summary_zh: 士兵们因极度口渴而痛苦不堪，有的呻吟，有的已无力呼喊，画面表现了他们濒临崩溃的状态。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: 曹操说：“大家挖一口井吧，这样我们就有水喝了！”可是，他们“吭哧吭哧”地挖了半天，也没见到一滴水。
page_text_en: Cao Cao said, "Let's dig a well, then we'll have water to drink!" But they dug hard for half a day, 'heave-ho, heave-ho,' and still didn't see a single drop of water.
summary_zh: 曹操命令士兵们挖井找水，但士兵们辛苦挖掘了半天，却一滴水也没挖到，依旧口渴难耐。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: 曹操心想：我们不能在这里停留太长时间，一定得想个办法走出去！
page_text_en: Cao Cao thought: We can't stay here for too long. We must find a way out!
summary_zh: 曹操看到士兵们因酷热和口渴而疲惫不堪，内心焦急，思考如何带领军队脱离困境。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: 看着路旁几棵干枯的大树，曹操突然有了主意。他站在高处，“唰”地一下抽出令旗指向前方，大声喊道：“有水啦！有水啦！”
page_text_en: Looking at a few withered trees by the roadside, Cao Cao suddenly had an idea. He stood on a high place, 'swish' pulled out his command flag and pointed it forward, shouting loudly: 'Water! Water!'
summary_zh: 曹操看到路边干枯的大树，灵机一动，站在高处抽出令旗指向前方，大声喊出有水，以激励士兵继续前进。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: 士兵们一听都来了精神，赶紧从地上爬了起来。
page_text_en: The soldiers, upon hearing this, immediately perked up and quickly got up from the ground.
summary_zh: 士兵们听到曹操的命令后精神振奋，纷纷从地上爬起来继续前进。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: 曹操说：“前面不远有一大片梅林，梅子又多又大，我们快快赶路，到那里吃梅子吧！”
page_text_en: Cao Cao said, "Not far ahead there is a large plum grove, with plenty of big plums. Let's hurry up and get there to eat them!"
summary_zh: 曹操站在高处，指着前方对士兵们说前面有大片梅林，梅子又多又大，激励他们快快赶路去吃梅子。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: 听曹操这么一说，士兵们马上想到了酸甜可口的梅子。
page_text_en: Hearing what Cao Cao said, the soldiers immediately thought of the sour and sweet plums.
summary_zh: 士兵们听到曹操说前方有梅林，立刻联想到酸甜可口的梅子，精神为之一振。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh:
大家想着梅子的
酸味，嘴里就流出了
不少口水，“唏溜唏溜”
地都咽到了肚子里。
page_text_en: Everyone thought of the sour taste of plums, and saliva began to flow from their mouths, 'slish-slish' they swallowed it all down.
summary_zh: 士兵们听到前方有梅林后，想起梅子的酸味，纷纷流出口水并咽下，精神振奋地继续前进。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: 嘴里有了口水，士兵们就不觉得那么渴了，他们有了精神，赶紧向前进发。
page_text_en: With saliva in their mouths, the soldiers no longer felt so thirsty. They regained their energy and hurried forward.
summary_zh: 士兵们因想到梅子而流口水，口渴感减轻，精神振奋，继续向前行进。

title_en: Quenching Thirst by Thinking of Plums
page_text_ocr_zh: 走啊走，曹操的军队终于来到了一片湖泊前。哈哈！这下大家可以喝个痛快啦！
page_text_en: Marching on, Cao Cao's army finally arrived at a lake. Haha! Now everyone can drink to their heart's content!
summary_zh: 曹操的军队终于抵达一片湖泊，士兵们欣喜若狂，准备痛快饮水解渴。
